- Tomato stem on a living plant, at a branching junction
- Elongated brown canker/lesion on the stem surface that has cracked open
- Internal brown pith/vascular discoloration visible through the crack
- Green healthy cortex tissue surrounding the lesion
- No white mycelium, no soft rot, no water-soaked appearance

The test image shows an **external canker** on the stem at a node, which is a hallmark of Bacterial Canker (Clavibacter michiganensis enters through leaf scars/wounds at nodes). The Southern_Bacterial_Wilt reference showed similar internal browning but as a fully split lab specimen, while the test image shows a canker developing on a living plant in the field. The KB confirms: "brown canker lesions on stems" for Bacterial Canker.
